Our story

Born from passion,
built on pride

I have always been in love with cigars, as my father was too. My main business is in the spirits industry — but I noticed that 60% of the top 100 best cigars in the world have one or two components from Ecuador, usually the binder or the wrapper: the ones that require the best quality tobacco.

I realised that Ecuador, despite producing some of the finest tobacco leaves in the world, has no Ecuadorean international brand in the market. So I decided to do something about it.

As a proud Ecuadorean, I launched Javier Olavarria Cigars — the first line of cigars made 100% with Ecuadorean leaves in the Filler, Binder, and Wrapper, and 100% handmade in Ecuador.

Our history

A legacy written in smoke

The beginning
Javier Olavarria grows up surrounded by a deep love of cigars, passed down from his father. His parallel career in the spirits industry sharpens his palate and his understanding of craft, quality, and connoisseurship.
The discovery
Javier discovers that 60% of the world's top 100 cigars use Ecuadorean tobacco — yet no Ecuadorean brand exists in the international market. A gap, and an opportunity.
The decision
As a proud Ecuadorean, Javier commits to creating the first premium cigar line made entirely from Ecuadorean tobacco — filler, binder, and wrapper — handrolled in Ecuador.
Today
Javier Olavarria Cigars launches with three flavour profiles and a range of classic vitolas, each individually numbered and produced in strictly limited quantities. Memento Vivere.

Tobacco plant anatomy

Understanding the leaf

Every Javier Olavarria cigar is built around a precise understanding of the tobacco plant. The position of each leaf on the stalk determines its character — from the light Volado at the base to the intense Ligero at the crown.

Ligero
Top leaves. Maximum sun — bold, full-flavoured, slow burning. Adds strength and complexity.
Viso
Upper-mid leaves. Balance of strength and aroma. Rich flavour with good combustion.
Seco
Mid leaves. Dry, aromatic, smooth. Provides elegance and even burn.
Volado
Base leaves. Light, combustible. Essential for an even draw and consistent burn.
